provenance_policy: official_source_url is set only when the URL returned HTTP 200 on the compile date and its page title named the authority (see verification.method). Service areas, jurisdictions and asset responsibilities marked 'unverified' come from public knowledge and MUST be confirmed against official notifications before routing is treated as final; the routing engine therefore asks for confirmation whenever it relies on an unverified fact. Never add contacts or URLs that have not been checked.

verification_statuses.url_verified: Official website reachable and page title names the authority (checked on last_verified).
verification_statuses.content_verified: Specific fact (e.g. helpline, served districts) read from the official website on last_verified.
verification_statuses.unverified: Not yet checked against an official source; routing that depends on it requires confirmation.
verification_statuses.unreachable: Candidate official URL did not respond on the compile date; URL withheld.
